fusions.name: Barb Left In
fusions.desc: Sends a guard bee from behind the shield that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slow Learner] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Comb Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of comb 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on that enemy spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sentries at the Entrance
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. A swarm of guard bees fights beside you for 9 seconds, stinging for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hive Answers
fusions.desc: 12% of the damage you take is stung back into whoever dealt it. You have 10% poison resistance.
